strings.en:
To the Doyen's Chosen,   
  
If you have been entrusted with this scroll, you've entered the deepest leyspring of Castora. This blessed place was discovered by the first elder a lifetime ago, and it houses an immense source of power that has taken all my strength to shield from the rest of Tyria, from even our own people. 
  
As tensions with the shadow stalkers escalate, I fear it is time to reveal all truths. We will need every drop of power in the moments to come, or seerkind may be absorbed into the Mists beyond.  
  
These halls were never meant to house us, so you will find little comfort within them. Here, you will reflect, prepare, and fortify for the battles ahead.  

When the root is almost dry, it will be time to depart.
